title: An Error Analysis of Flow Matching for Deep Generative Modeling
summary: Core proof-chain defects in covariance, approximation construction and rate balance; partial identities and bounded corrections verified.

problems.title: False covariance lower bound on bounded convex support
problems.claim: LemmaD8 on arbitrary convex support; Eq69 -> Lemma1.4 -> Theorem1.7
assumptions: Omega=[0,1], U=y^2/2+logZ, smooth convex positive normalized density
For target interpretation alpha=2 and independent Gaussian prior
problems.check: Exact variance bound <=1/4 contradicts claimed1; quadrature and conditional derivative formula
problems.result: D8 false; global smooth-potential/compact-support assumptions incompatible; on-support interpretation gives diverging Lipschitz constant
problems.counterevidence: Full-support versions can require boundary conditions; weaker LemmaD6 survives this issue
problems.impact: Invalid core derivation of improved rate, not proof that all FM learning fails

independent_verification.original_claim_and_location: Read physical pp1-2 Assumptions1.1-1.2/Lemma1.4, p28 LemmaD.8, p29 Eq69 and p30 bound; visually confirmed pp2,28,29.
independent_verification.operative_assumptions: For LemmaD.8, convex Omega=[0,1], U(y)=y^2/2+logZ is C2, normalized and strictly convex with Usecond=1. For the support-only reading of Assumption1.2, alpha=2 is admissible and the Gaussian prior is independent. A finite global C2 potential with e^-V on all R instead cannot have compact support, and the report separates that vacuous interpretation.
independent_verification.decisive_check: Variance on [0,1] is at most1/4 by centering at1/2, contradicting the claimed lower bound1 independently of quadrature. At x=0 the posterior is exp(-A*y^2/2) on[0,1], A=1+t^2/(1-t)^2. Differentiating the conditional mean gives dv=t*Var/(1-t)^3-1/(1-t). A fresh analytic truncated-normal moment computation at t=.99 gives -63.298671153224404, exceeding the printed Lipschitz bound8 in magnitude. Scaled variance tends1-2/pi, hence(1-t)dv tends-2/pi and the derivative diverges.
independent_verification.alternatives_and_counterevidence: The counterexample has nonzero boundary density, precisely the condition omitted by unqualified boundary-free Cramer-Rao reasoning. It refutes printed D.8 and the on-support extension, not a global-potential theorem with empty assumptions. Weaker D.6 avoids this lower bound.
independent_verification.core_dependency_and_severity: Major retained: Eq69 supplies the cancellation in D.9/1.4 used in TheoremC.5/1.7. This does not refute all FM learning or prove the existential improved learning rate impossible under some different assumptions.
independent_verification.repair_scope: No complete repair is certified. Moving to a full-support target would require altered tail/approximation assumptions, not only a substitution into Eq69.

problems.title: Sharp cutoff approximation construction incompatible with continuity
problems.claim: Uniform approximation on closed cube plus zero outside with global Lipschitz ReLU network
assumptions: X1 point mass0, d1, T<1, R>epsilon
problems.check: Continuity forces boundaryvalue0 but truevelocity=-R at t0; exact partition endpoint sum0
problems.result: Displayed construction cannot have stated properties; existential L2 theorem not disproved
problems.counterevidence: Enlarged support taper/endpoints plausible but requires new analysis
problems.impact: Core approximation proof gap propagates to both end-to-end arguments

independent_verification.original_claim_and_location: Read and visually checked AppendixA.1 p12, read p13 explicit zero-outside and global-Lipschitz assertion; checked p3 convention[N]={0,...,N-1} and Theorem3.1 p4.
independent_verification.operative_assumptions: Point-mass X1=0 is allowed by bounded-support Assumption1.1; for any T<1 its velocity -x/(1-t) is spatially Lipschitz as required by Theorem3.1. Finite ReLU networks are continuous; no target density premise is added for this theorem.
independent_verification.decisive_check: At t=0 the true boundary value is-R. Continuous network zero on x>R has value0 atR and error at leastR, inconsistent with arbitrary uniform epsilon<R on the closed cube. Independently, the printed indices at xprime=1 give3(N-m)>=3 so every trapezoid term vanishes; at xprime=-1/(6N), m=0 contributes1. Fresh exact rational evaluation checked N=1,2,4,10.
independent_verification.alternatives_and_counterevidence: A correct cited approximation construction or enlarged-cube taper could supply a replacement, but is not the displayed sharp cutoff. Omitting a single endpoint is insufficient for continuous uniform approximation near a nonzero boundary. This is not an impossibility proof for an L2 approximation theorem.
independent_verification.core_dependency_and_severity: Major retained for the claimed construction supporting Theorem3.1, Theorem4.4 and both end-to-end guarantees; the distinction between failed construction and false existential statement is preserved.
independent_verification.repair_scope: Endpoint nodes and a taper require new global Lipschitz and tail estimates. No such complete repair is claimed.

problems.title: Mesh exponent fails supplied improved-rate balance
problems.claim: h=O(n^-4a), s=n^-a inserted into error bound gives Otilde(n^-a)
problems.location: Theorem1.7 p2; Theorem3.1 p4; C.5 pp24-25
problems.check: gamma2*h has exponent0; estimation and stop terms exponent-a
problems.result: Supplied bound alone is Otilde(1), not desired rate; actual numerical error not lower-bounded
problems.counterevidence: Smaller h=n^-5a lies within displayed big-O and repairs balance conditionally
problems.impact: Core improved-rate proof step incomplete; independent of other findings
problems.correction: h=O(n^-5a) sufficient for this algebra only

independent_verification.original_claim_and_location: Read Theorem3.1 p4 and A.1 p13 network time-Lipschitz parameter gamma2, C.5 pp24-25 and Theorem1.7 p2; visually confirmed p25 final substitution.
independent_verification.operative_assumptions: Conditionally grant prior lemmas; fixed alpha,d, a=1/[3(d+5)], s=n^-a; network bounds K=Otilde(s^-1), gamma2=Otilde(s^-4). A uniform mesh of maximum step proportional to n^-4a is allowed.
independent_verification.decisive_check: For a uniform mesh sqrt(sum dt^3)=h*sqrtT. The gamma2*h bound has exponent4a-4a=0, while stopping and estimation exponents are-a and2a-1/(d+5)=-a. Therefore the published substitutions alone provide Otilde(1), not the claimed decaying bound. This is explicitly an upper-bound insufficiency, not a lower bound on actual Euler error.
independent_verification.alternatives_and_counterevidence: h=O(n^-5a) lies in O(n^-4a), so an existential choice can satisfy the text. The insufficient condition alone does not specify that choice. A sharper gamma2 estimate or other discretization analysis might also repair the step, but none is established here.
independent_verification.core_dependency_and_severity: Major retained on the invalid derivation of the central improved rate, without asserting that the final theorem is false independently of the preceding assumption issues.
independent_verification.repair_scope: The stronger step size makes gamma2*h=Otilde(n^-a) conditional on the rest of the argument. It does not repair P1 or P2.
